payload.reason: M2.4 Slice 2 is approved and the M2.4 unit is authorized to transition to COMPLETED. The dedicated feature suite provides explicit coverage for all six implemented Seminar endpoints: authentication and response negotiation, syllabus upload and CourseFile persistence, statutory rubric validation and evaluation persistence, multi-assessor averaging with AcademicMark synchronization, schedule persistence, all three print-report modes, and NBA direct attainment calculation. The statutory Clause 11.2.6 rubric bounds and SBTE grading scale are explicitly exercised, including representative grade and number-to-words behavior. The reported 10 dedicated tests with 59 assertions pass, and the full application suite passes with 47 tests and 350 assertions with zero failures or regressions. The reported ISNULL-to-CASE replacement is a targeted cross-database compatibility correction within the authorized controller whitelist and does not introduce duplicate infrastructure. Existing Seminar models, CourseFile, AcademicMark, AttainmentService, and related persistence are reused. No migrations, destructive database operations, unapproved application files, or User.php changes were introduced. The mandatory global UI directives remain applicable to the later M2.5 presentation/print migration; this backend-only M2.4 unit introduces no UI duplication. The verification evidence is sufficient to close M2.4.
